topics.label: Welcome and Lecture Framing
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture series, outlines the learning objectives, and frames the discussion of cancer evolution and the tumor microenvironment.

topics.label: Genetic and Epigenetic Drivers of Clonal Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how successive driver mutations and non-mutational epigenetic alterations confer selective growth advantages to clones during Darwinian tumor evolution.

topics.label: Cell of Origin and Cancer Stem Cell Hierarchies
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the cancer stem cell model and evaluate experimental evidence identifying how specific cells of origin influence tumor initiation and hierarchical organization.

topics.label: Microenvironmental Regulation, Inflammation, and Tumor Coevolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics analyze how inflammatory and stromal microenvironments promote tumor development and maintenance, how these interactions are mapped experimentally, and how cancer cells coevolve with their surroundings.

topics.label: Closing Remarks and Next Lecture
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the concluding framing and previews the upcoming lecture on cancer therapy.
